CustomField.description: Whether SAL requires the Lead to be owned by an individual Salesforce User rather than a Queue. THE GOVERNED NORTHSTARIQ POLICY, NOT SALESFORCE BEHAVIOUR - Salesforce permits queue-owned records at any stage, and plenty of legitimate operating models accept into a pod or a shared book and name an individual later. This synthetic business decided otherwise: sales acceptance is the transfer of operational responsibility to an accountable person, so a coverage queue is valid routing ownership before seller pickup and insufficient ownership once SAL is claimed. An ACCOUNTABILITY check, not a routing rule: the safeguard verifies that a seller has taken the Lead, and never assigns ownership itself. Switching this off restores the ownership semantics in force before it existed, in both the Flow and the NorthstarIQ assessment.
CustomField.label: Require Individual Accountable Owner
